## Crystal Dragon, Mature Adult (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
 CG Large dragon (earth)  
 **Init** +1; **Senses** dragon senses, tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +21; **Aura** frightful presence (210 ft., DC 23)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 30, touch 10, flat-footed 29 (+1 Dex, +20 natural, -1 size)  
 **hp** 172 (15d12+75)  
 **Fort** +16, **Ref** +12, **Will** +12  
 **DR** 10/magic; **Immune** paralysis, sleep, sonic; **SR** 22  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 60 ft., burrow 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor)  
 **Melee** bite +22 (2d6+10/19-20), 2 claws +21 (1d8+7), tail slap +19 (1d8+10), 2 wings +19 (1d6+3)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (40-ft. cone, 14d4 sonic, DC 22)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 15th; concentration +21)  

  At will—*[color spray](../../magic/spells/color-spray.md)* (DC 17), *[glitterdust](../../magic/spells/glitterdust.md)* (DC 18), *[rainbow pattern](../../magic/spells/rainbow-pattern.md)* (DC 20)  

 **Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 3rd; concentration +9)  

  1st (7/day)—*[magic aura](../../magic/spells/magic-aura.md)*, *[silent image](../../magic/spells/silent-image.md)* (DC 17), *[unseen servant](../../magic/spells/unseen-servant.md)*  
 0 (at will)—*[acid splash](../../magic/spells/acid-splash.md)*, *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 25, **Dex** 12, **Con** 21, **Int** 16, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 22  
 **Base Atk** +15; **CMB** +23; **CMD** 34 (38 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Deceitful, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (bite), Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite)  
 **Skills** Bluff +28, Climb +33, Disguise +25, Fly +13, Intimidate +24, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +21, Perception +21, Sense Motive +21, Stealth +15; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Climb  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic, Terran, Undercommon  
 **SQ** razor sharp  

**Special Abilities**

 **Razor Sharp (Sp)**  All of a crystal dragon’s natural attacks deal slashing damage.  

  
  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any underground (Plane of Earth)  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
